responsibility: Declares newer RTL analysis abstractions layered on top of the broader rtlanal functionality in rtl.h/rtlanal.cc. It defines MEM_REGNO, rtx_obj_reference flags and records for describing register or variable-memory accesses, rtx_properties collectors with growable storage for enumerating reads/writes/clobbers and side effects within an rtx or insn, and selected analysis predicates such as vector highpart/lowpart recognition and paradoxical-subreg detection.
same_name_distinction: Defines the newer rtlanal-specific analysis abstractions such as MEM_REGNO, rtx_obj_reference, rtx_properties, and vec_rtx_properties, plus a small set of predicate declarations; unlike gcc/rtlanal.cc, it is not the large historical implementation of general RTL analysis utilities.
